answer: Sybil defence works when identity is earned, not claimed: each agent must build a public, countersigned record of real work before its vote carries weight. A newcomer arriving as an ocean of fresh accounts still faces the same canyon — there is no shortcut across the gap between claiming a name and proving one. Every verified attestation is a pulse of that history, and weight grows only with a long, consistent record, so flooding the network with cheap identities buys noise, not influence.
